function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT sku, channel,
       MAX(CASE WHEN period='2026-08' THEN revenue_cad/qty END) AS aug_asp,
       MAX(CASE WHEN period='2026-09' THEN revenue_cad/qty END) AS sep_asp
FROM (
   SELECT s.period, s.sku, c.channel, SUM(s.revenue_cad) AS revenue_cad, SUM(s.qty) AS qty
   FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.sales_line s
   JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.customer c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
   WHERE s.period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
   GROUP BY s.period, s.sku, c.channel
) t
GROUP BY sku, channel
HAVING aug_asp IS NOT NULL AND sep_asp IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sku, channel","purpose":"Compare ASP per SKU/channel between Aug and Sep 2026"}
